correctness.rationale: The four-angle-to-two-lines transformation gives the exact arcsine line-offset density and the Jacobian |sin(phi-psi)|. The lens scales as delta^(3/2) to a parabolic region of area 4/3. Each one-singular-angle sector contributes pi log(1/delta), while the doubly singular sector has vanishing normalized contribution. Uniform integrability follows from log-bound integrability over the lens, giving an L1 limit 2pi and hence both the coefficient 8/(3pi^3) and the total-variation conditional law. Boundary and parallel-line degeneracies are null events. Independent Cartesian simulation and Gaussian quadrature corroborate the result, not replace proof.

value.rationale: Two independently sampled geometric networks on nearly tangent circles have an intrinsically shrinking lens and singular endpoint-uniform chord ensemble. The exact delta^(3/2) logarithmic crossing law and complete anisotropic conditional intersection distribution solve a natural localized random-junction problem not implied by the previously inspected common-center laws. The result gives a sharp singular coefficient, spatial profile, and explicit limiting marginal and moment, not a routine numerical refinement.
